public_site_goal: Transform the Rig Relay static site renderer output from an internal evidence console into a public-facing product website suitable for investors, headhunters, technical reviewers, and open-source users.

metadata_checks.og_tags: All pages emit og:title, og:type, og:description, og:site_name, og:locale via base template.
metadata_checks.twitter_cards: All pages emit twitter:card, twitter:title, twitter:description via base template.
metadata_checks.canonical_urls: All pages include rel=canonical with deterministic paths.
metadata_checks.robots_meta: All pages include meta robots defaulting to index,follow.
metadata_checks.favicon: Favicon SVG linked in base template head.

mobile_checks.viewport_meta: All pages include width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0 viewport meta.
mobile_checks.touch_targets: Interactive elements have min-height 44px in CSS.
mobile_checks.overflow_handling: pre/code blocks use overflow-x auto; long paths wrap.

social_preview_checks.og_image_status: Static PNG and SVG OG cards generated and copied to output.
social_preview_checks.og_fields_complete: og:title, og:type, og:url, og:image, og:description, og:site_name, og:locale present.

crawler_checks.sitemap_generated: sitemap.xml generated with all page URLs.
crawler_checks.internal_links_valid: All internal page links resolve to generated files.
crawler_checks.canonical_urls_unique: Each page has a unique canonical URL.

structured_data_checks.json_ld_valid: JSON-LD blocks parse as valid JSON.
structured_data_checks.homepage_structured_data: Homepage includes WebSite and SoftwareApplication JSON-LD.

performance_checks.no_external_fonts: CSS uses system fonts only, no external font loading.
performance_checks.no_external_scripts: No external script tags in generated HTML.
performance_checks.css_local_only: Single local CSS file, no CDN dependencies.

accessibility_checks.skip_links: Skip-to-content link present on all pages.
accessibility_checks.keyboard_focus: Focus outlines present for all interactive elements.
accessibility_checks.aria_landmarks: Proper header, nav, main, footer landmarks.
accessibility_checks.heading_hierarchy: Single H1 per page, no skipped heading levels.

security_checks.html_escaping: All dynamic content escaped via Jinja2 autoescape.
security_checks.csp_headers: Content-Security-Policy meta tag restricts script/style sources.
security_checks.no_unsafe_insertion: No | safe filters, no innerHTML usage.
security_checks.content_light_scrubbing: Repository paths stripped from raw artifact payloads.

claims_supported: Refusal-first capability boundaries with shared vocabulary
Content-light receipts that never leak secrets
Local provider and protocol readiness with capability manifests
Public evidence artifacts validated against 246+ schemas
Mobile-responsive static site with no JavaScript dependency
Social preview metadata for link unfurling
Sitemap and robots.txt for crawler discoverability
PNG OG card generated for link previews on non-SVG crawlers
claims_rejected: Automatic dynamic OG image generation based on page content
Real-time live data on static pages
remaining_seams: 92+ legacy Markdown audits in docs/audits/ not yet migrated to JSON.
Structured data types limited to WebSite, SoftwareApplication, TechArticle, BreadcrumbList.
No contact email or social media URLs available for CTA links.
Asset fingerprinting not implemented; deterministic digest used instead.
recommendation: The static site renderer now produces a public-facing product website with evidence-backed claims, social metadata, mobile responsiveness, sitemap, robots.txt, and structured data. Ready for public deployment with noted seams.
